categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Carries the macOS label and resolves a macOS-specific runtime failure caused by select() returning EINVAL for large timeouts.
categories.rationale: Fixes a platform-specific regression where `bitcoin-cli -rpcclienttimeout=0` fails immediately on macOS with 'Could not connect to the server'. While it does not prevent the node or tool from running under normal flags, supported-platform breakage on standard options warrants priority attention before release.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies `src/util/sock.cpp` to cap timeout values in `Sock::WaitMany`.
categories.rationale: Corrects an edge case in the `Sock::WaitMany` primitive where infinite/multi-year wait durations cause system call failures or parameter overflow. Ensuring shared socket utilities handle large timeouts safely prevents unexpected socket errors across callers.
